text:
elena: FYI we've got an oddity in staging-private: KMS Decrypt calls peaking for svcacc `build-runner@staging` at 02:31 UTC. noticed because the private KMS audit feed spiked. can someone sanity-check? :mag:
ben: which namespace? any recent CRB changes?
elena: namespace `staging-redwood`. I checked `kubectl get clusterrolebinding --watch` and noticed `adhoc-crb` created around 02:28 by CI pipeline `infra-ci`.
kai: looking at audit logs: `2026-03-18T02:31:05Z KMSDecrypt key=projects/priv-kms/keys/ephemeral-2 caller=serviceAccount:staging-redwood:build-runner`
ben: that SA should only have access to storage, not KMS. who applied the CRB?
ei: (typo) elena: whoops, meant "elena".
ops-oncall: auto-mitigations recommended: 1) rotate token by deleting SA secret, 2) delete the CRB, 3) apply networkpolicy egress deny on namespace, 4) escalate if more than one key touched.
ben: commands ready: `kubectl delete clusterrolebinding adhoc-crb` and `kubectl delete secret $(kubectl get sa build-runner -n staging-redwood -o jsonpath='{.secrets[0].name}') -n staging-redwood`
kai: I'm capturing KMS audit export: creating GCS blob with raw entries. auditbot: export created at gs://redwood-internal/audits/staging/2026-03-18/kms-spike.json
elena: throwing a small NetworkPolicy snippet here; note we only allow to internal kms-proxy IPs and platform metrics collector:
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: staging-temporary-egress-block
  namespace: staging-redwood
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.30.40.0/24
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```
ops-oncall: applied netpol; observed KMS decrypt rate drop to normal in ~45s.
ben: going to scan other clusters for similar adhoc-crb. if we see pattern, escalate to infra-sec.
kai: found identical CRB created in eu-private at 02:29 by same CI job runner identity.
elena: oof. sounds like a pipeline step that runs with elevated perms. we need pipeline RBAC guardrails.
ben: action items here: 1) disable CRB creation from CI tokens (OPA gate), 2) inventory all CRBs created in last 7 days and flag unexpected SAs, 3) create KMS decrypt spike alert with threshold tuned for private clusters, 4) add automated netpol fallback to playbook.
ops-oncall: opening ticket SEC-2026-4882; severity: medium. mitigation state: mitigated.
auditbot: attached KMS and kube-apiserver logs to SEC-2026-4882.
eli: (typo again) elena: added owners: ben (rbac triage), kai (audit logs + KMS policy), elena (playbook update).
ben: do we want default egress-deny on private clusters? higher isolation would have prevented this. but we need a migration plan since many workloads expect outbound internet.
kai: propose staged approach: default deny on non-prod first, enforce internal proxies for required external egress, and provide a compatibility test harness.
elena: agree. i'll create an epic and assign stakeholders. closing for now.
